E1_gap.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap on PERSISTED detector streams only (p2 P-REP M1/M2/M4 atk+cal; m3_scores s42-44): blocks {5,10,30} windows, 1000 reps, seed 42; resample attack sequence and benign-calib sequence independently; report 2.5/97.5 percentiles as descriptive stability, NOT inference
E1_gap.table_source: tables/T0_modality_confound.csv (cross_phase_auc, within_phase_auc) — the paper's detector-score comparison
E1_gap.within: labeled attack windows vs buffered non-action windows (1053; +-300 s)

E2_result2_session_auc.definition: benign-calib (present) vs attack-recording windows with no attack label (present); same quantity as T0 confound_auc

E2_synthetic.A: actual ProvICS attack label vector (128 positives) and buffered-background mask (1053)
metrics: AUC_within (R1 attack vs R1 buffered background)
E2_synthetic.rationale: beta=1, sigma=1 gives within AUC Phi(1/sqrt2)~0.76, near the observed M4 within value; fixed before running; no pilot

E3_pre_action.definition: attack-recording windows whose END <= first labeled action start (2026-04-16T13:08:41.416Z); n=274; zero overlap with any label
report: fraction of pre-action windows above calib median
E3_pre_action.threshold: 98.6th percentile of benign-calib probe scores (1.4% nominal exceedance)

metric: pre-action alarm rate at 1.4% calib threshold

E6_calibration.detector_streams: stageA GRU (seeds 42-44) per held-out campaign; per-modality mods_pfc streams (M1..M4, seeds 42-44)
metrics: UA/h (unmatched alarm episodes per test hour)

references.A: historical non-action: last 30% (chronological) of no-label windows with window_start < held-out campaign start
references.B: strict pre-action: the 274 windows ending before the first labeled action
references.C: buffered historical non-action: as A but excluding windows within +-300 s of any labeled action (state buffer_excluded)

session_probe.rows: only windows where the view is present
